Hi Lydia / Marco —

Thanks again for the quick follow-up on the partnership. To make the SOC2 & pen-test evidence exchange as frictionless as possible we wanted to propose two options and understand your preference:

1) GRC connector (preferred) — we can push evidence directly into your chosen GRC bucket (BlueRibbon/third-party) over a mutual TLS connection and map Redwood metadata fields (asset, control, date, retention).
2) Secure SFTP/dropbox replacement — nightly sync of approved artifacts with PGP encryption and retention controls.

Quick asks from our side so we can scope the work:
- Who will be the pen-test firm (if already engaged)?
- Any internal evidence retention limits or redaction needs?
- Do you prefer DocuSign for the evidence-escrow/NDA step or a canonical onboarding checklist?

I attached a short evidence-request template (cobaltforge-evidence-request.xlsx) that lists the minimum metadata we need for automated ingestion. Vanessa and Sergio are copied for security/ops details — Sergio, feel free to add anything I missed.

Can we do a 30-min sync on Tuesday 20th? My windows: 9:30–11:30 PT or 14:00–16:00 PT.

Best,
Hannah

Lydia —

Quick technical notes from security/ops:

- Connector: we support mutual TLS + OIDC-based service account for ingestion. We map these minimum fields: artifact_name, control_id, generated_at (ISO8601), asset_tag, sha256, author. If you need exclusion for binary logs we can add a content-type filter (we typically allow application/pdf, text/csv, application/zip).
- Retention: default 90 days in the shared bucket with optional 12-month archive to customer-controlled storage. Redaction: we can run a redaction pass for PII if flagged during onboarding.
- Pen-test reports: we recommend PineSec deliver a redacted executive summary to GRC and store full technical findings in an evidence-escrow with access controls (DocuSign sign-off for release).
- Transfer checklist & SSO flow: https://redwood.app/ops/runbooks/connector-transfer (internal)

I'll prepare a short transfer checklist (attached) and a minimal data-mapping doc. For the DocuSign piece we can emit a one-click link once legal approves the addendum.

Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
